newsitem.title: USA: TABLE - Advanced Tissue Sciences Q2 results.
newsitem.headline: TABLE - Advanced Tissue Sciences Q2 results.

text.p: Three Months Ended Six Months Ended
(a) Product sales in the three and six month periods ended June 30, 1997 include sales of $222,000 to a related party at cost.

(b) Contracts and fees for the three and six month periods ended June 30, 1996 include a $10 million up front payment from Smith & Nephew upon the formation of the joint venture for the commercialization of Dermagraft in the treatment of diabetic foot ulcers. Excluding the $10 million payment, the Company would have had a net loss of $8.1 million or $.22 per share and $15.1 million or $.42 per share for the three and six months ended June 30, 1996, respectively.

(c) During 1997, the Company has borrowed $11.7 million from its joint venture partner, Smith & Nephew, as provided under its joint venture agreements. An additional $8.3 million remains available to the Company under these loan facilities.

(d) As of June 30, 1997, the Company had cash and investments of $23.4 million, after expenditures of $10.2 million for the expansion of its Dermagraft manufacturing facilities. In August 1997, a subsidiary of the Company entered into a term loan agreement with The Chase Manhattan Bank for up to $16 million, which the Company will apply toward the costs associated with the facilities expansion. The Company expects to draw a substantial portion of the loan in 1997, and the balance in early 1998.
